access_key_id.description: AWS access key id for SigV4 signing. Never logged.

secret_access_key.description: AWS secret access key for SigV4 signing. Never logged or previewed.

endpoint.description: DynamoDB JSON API endpoint, e.g. https://dynamodb.us-east-1.amazonaws.com. Required for live mode unless base_url is set.

streams_endpoint.description: Optional DynamoDB Streams endpoint. Defaults to endpoint when unset.

region.description: AWS region used in SigV4 credential scope.

table_name.description: Default DynamoDB table name for table-scoped reads and writes.

table_arn.description: Default table ARN for ARN-scoped operations.

resource_arn.description: Default resource ARN for resource policy/tag operations.

stream_arn.description: Default DynamoDB Stream ARN for Streams operations.

shard_id.description: Default shard id for DynamoDB Streams shard-iterator reads.

page_size.description: Bounded per-request Limit/MaxResults/PageSize where the operation supports it.

mode.description: Runtime mode: live (default) or fixture for credential-free tests.

transact_get_items.description: Optional JSON TransactItems fixture/config for TransactGetItems stream tests only; not exposed as a generic CLI passthrough.
